intro: The Orth table is where minimalism meets utility. With its clean lines, dual-tone finish, and sturdy build, it brings effortless sophistication and practical storage to your home.

features.title: Clean lines that calm and simplify
features.text: Bring subtle sophistication into your home with clean lines and a minimalist design that never goes out of style.

features.title: Stone and wood finish warms your home
features.text: Add warmth and depth to your room—Sonoma Oak and Greystone Dark finishes bring a modern yet inviting touch.

features.title: Compact shape that hugs your walls
features.text: Tight on space? Our thoughtful design nestles snugly into corners, maximising your room’s potential.

features.title: Functional shelves for easy storage
features.text: Convenient storage compartments discreetly tuck away clutter, so your living space always feels calm, polished, and perfectly put together.

features.title: HDMR build stands up to daily use
features.text: Built with high-density materials, our table stands up to daily life with ease. Whether it’s a coffee mug or your favourite décor, it’s made to last.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
